title: spring metal bunny figures
text: spring metal bunny figures. I purchased these for my spring decor display - they are so cute.  They are painted metal.  They stand around 6" or 7" tall.  They are very cute and look folksy to me.  They are rabbits - but I think will look fine even after Easter because the rabbits are holding flowers - not easter eggs.  Just my opinion.  You get 2... one boy bunny, one girl bunny.  They are pretty lightweight but do stand up.

product_metadata.title: Easter Bunny Decoration Indoor for Home and Table - Decorative Metal Bunny, Set of 2
features: The Days Are Getting Longer, the Nights Shorter. The Sun is showing its face again, the temperatures are rising and flowers are popping up. Spring is coming. Easter is also inevitably just around the corner. So don't just your spring decorations out - brighten up your home too with the latest Easter decorations. What are arguably the most important Easter decorations? That's obvious! Easter Eggs, decorative chicks and of course Easter bunnies!

These decorative Easter bunnies are bound to impress with their sophisticated retro look. The shabby Easter bunny can be used for a variety of applications. Place on a sideboard or dresser, shelving or window sills or use the decorative bunnies as Easter table decorations.

Yet this Easter bunny set is not just a beautiful Easter decoration for your home, but also a great gift for your loved ones. So what are you waiting for? Give your loved ones a treat or smarten up your home with these decorative metal bunnies.
The Easter bunnies come as a set of 2. They includes a small female bunny (6.2 inches) and a large bunny (7.48 inches). The bunnies are made from metal and have a vintage look.

This Easter bunny decoration from khevga is made of metal. This metal is colourfully painted in cream, red, green and white. The metal bunny comes as set of 2 and stands out in particular thanks to its elaborate design with a vintage look. The decorative Easter set consists of a small Easter bunny (height 6.2 inches) and a larger decorative bunny (height 7.48 inches)
These vintage Easter bunnies are a wonderful Easter bunny pair. Both bunnies hold flowers in their hands and are an excellent decorative two
